final_decision.madr_content:
# ADR-1042: Standardize on TOML Configuration Format

* Status: **Accepted**
* Date: 2024-03-15
* Deciders: @charliermarsh, @dev-contributor-alex, @frontend-dev-sam, @maintainer-marcus, @security-auditor-eva
* Source Discussion: [Decide on configuration file format: TOML vs YAML vs JSON](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/1042)

## Context and Problem Statement

Engineering evaluation and decision required for: Decide on configuration file format: TOML vs YAML vs JSON

Project settings, CLI arguments, and dependency constraints require a robust, standardized configuration file format.

## Considered Options

* TOML Configuration Format *(Chosen)*
* YAML Configuration Format *(Rejected)*
* JSON Configuration Format *(Rejected)*

## Decision Outcome

Chosen option: **Standardize on TOML configuration format (pyproject.toml / uv.toml)**, because:
We commit to TOML as the single official configuration file format. Settings will be parsed from [tool.uv] in pyproject.toml with fallback to standalone uv.toml.

### Positive Consequences

* Strict alignment with Python packaging standards PEP 518 and PEP 621
* First-class comment support allows developers to document settings directly inline
* Unambiguous typing prevents type coercion security bugs common in YAML
* High-performance serde deserialization in Rust via toml-rs

### Negative Consequences (Trade-offs)

* DevOps engineers accustomed to YAML will need minor syntax adjustment
* Multi-line strings have specific syntax compared to YAML blocks

## Pros and Cons of Rejected Options

### YAML Configuration (.uv.yaml)
* Proposed by: @dev-contributor-alex
* Rejection reasons:
  * ❌ Severe security risks and arbitrary code execution CVEs in standard YAML parsers
  * ❌ Norway problem ('NO' interpreted as boolean False) causing silent configuration errors
  * ❌ Complex indentation rules causing formatting bugs across environments
* Key objection quote: - @security-auditor-eva ([Source](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/1042#issuecomment-102))
  > "YAML is notoriously difficult to parse securely due to arbitrary type coercion and code execution CVEs in standard parsers."

### JSON Configuration
* Proposed by: @frontend-dev-sam
* Rejection reasons:
  * ❌ Strict lack of comments prevents documenting complex build and packaging settings
  * ❌ Trailing commas and strict syntax make human manual editing prone to syntax errors
* Key objection quote: - @maintainer-marcus ([Source](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/1042#issuecomment-104))
  > "JSON is disqualified because configuration files need comments."

## Code Grounding & Impacted Components

The following files, modules, and directories are bound to this decision:

* `pyproject.toml`
* `uv.toml`
* `crates/uv-settings/*`
* `crates/uv-configuration/*`
* `config/loader.py`
* `config.py`
* `crates/uv-settings/src/lib.rs`

## Verified Evidence Citations

| eq-3 | "Consensus reached: We accept TOML as the single official configuration format. Rejected YAML due to security vulnerabilities and typing ambiguities. Rejected JSON due to absence of comment support. Implemented in PR #1045." | @maintainer-marcus | ✅ Verified | [Comment c-107](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/1042#issuecomment-107) |
